## What you’ll see on this trip

Your trip starts in Panama City, where you’ll visit both historic and modern districts and see the Miraflores Locks on the Panama Canal. Spend a separate day in Chagres National Park, travelling by dugout canoe through the jungle and meeting the Emberá people to learn about their culture and traditions.

In Costa Rica, the route takes you to Poás Volcano and La Paz Waterfall Gardens, the Arenal area, the Caño Negro Wildlife Refuge and the cloud forests of Monteverde. The tour ends on the Pacific coast at Manuel Antonio, where the tropical forest meets the beaches.
